name: Explain and export a fit result
userOutcome: A user can understand the score's subjective provenance and create a scorecard or entitled reveal clip that opens in the system share or Photos flow.
productionDataSource: Persisted FitSession values plus the locally stored original image, rendered by ScorecardRenderer or RevealVideoRenderer.
errorBehavior: Rendering and Photos-save failures do not report success and leave the saved session intact. A missing original uses an explicit visual placeholder and never fabricates a user photo.
accessibilityRequirements: Metric values and style-lock state are announced
Share, Save, and Reveal controls have distinct labels and disabled state
Score meaning is available without relying on color
prohibitedBehavior: Do not report saved or shared before the system operation succeeds
Do not call a heuristic result a model confidence
Do not remove watermarks or unlock reveal clips without entitlement
acceptanceTests: Manual open-and-inspect of scorecard PNG and reveal video on device
Manual Photos add-permission grant, deny, and revoke checks
